classes.description: A question with a recommended option about how to do the work inside the approved scope, such as a design, naming, ordering or tooling choice.
Approval at a named flow gate, such as a package, scope, plan or review approval the flow asks the user for.
The flow's own merge step on its recorded PR head, once its required checks pass; never a provider or Git merge of another head.
Publishing a release or a tag.
Starting a Requirement, a Delivery or another phase that is not already in flight.
Creating, reading, entering or changing a credential, token, key or password.
Changing a security, authorization, permission or sandbox setting, or granting access the work needs.
Spending money, such as buying a paid service, seat or quota.
An action that cannot be undone, such as deleting data, rewriting published history or removing work the flow does not own.
A change to the approved scope or an external contract, an exception to an approved rule or project invariant, or a budget the approved documents leave open: the decisions a flow asks at once.

goal_kinds.description: Until one Delivery reaches a terminal status: merged or cancelled.
Until one Requirement ends its planning: incorporated into the approved backlog, resolved with no change, superseded or withdrawn.
A free-text goal that no compiler can read. It ends only through complete, off or its cap.
